title: Orlando Pirates news: Mbule, Mabasa, Mbappe, Ndlovu
text:
Orlando Pirates news: Mbule, Mabasa, Mbappe, Ndlovu
Today’s news wrap for fans of the champions.
Today’s Orlando Pirates news wrap looks at several ins and outs, including a replacement for Sipho Mbule. And remember when Mbappe’s name was on a Pirates jersey?
Mabasa to leave Orlando Pirates, Kaizer Chiefs interested
When quizzed on his next move after a loan spell with Stellenbosch, striker Tshegofatso Mabasa has indicated that no concrete decisions have been made. Despite his output of four goals in 14 outings, the Winelands side has said it won’t be signing the 29-year-old permanently. Another man who’s left the building is Sipho Mbule, whose contract has expired. Pirates have chosen not to extend the 28-year-old’s deal.
Champion Pirates sign Ndlovu
Pirates have wrapped up the signing of in-demand winger Siyanda Ndlovu from Golden Arrows, a player with four goals and six assists from 25 appearances in the league last term. Get a scouting report via Siseko Gwegwe to hear what he brings to the club.
World Cup fun
World Cup 2010 is something that none of us will ever forget. What a majestic experience. Turn to the person next to you right now and tell them where you were and how you felt when Kaizer Chiefs legend Siphiwe Tshabalala lashed Bafana Bafana into the lead against Mexico. The 2026 edition is exactly a week away, with Mexico vs Bafana Bafana kicking off the showpiece at the Estadio Azteca on 11 June at 21:00 CAT.
2018 champions and 2022 runners-up France will be led by the one and only Kylian Mbappe. Remember when this Mbappe shirt made an appearance at a Soweto Derby?
Who will win the 2026 World Cup? Let us know by clicking the comments tab below 🙂
